nodes.title: Read me first
widgets_values:
# Video → .sogst (Cumuli)

**Load Video → Generate Ring → Stage → Masks → Dataset → Train → Bake → Preview.**
One monocular clip in, a streamable 4D gaussian splat in the output gallery
(~1.5 h total on a 32 GB card: ring ~25 min with the default `enable_turbo`,
training ~1 h).

## Configuration lives in ComfyUI's Settings
Open **Settings → search "Cumuli"**: work root (heavy intermediates,
~20 GB/run → `<work_root>/<run>/`), the loader dropdowns' discovery
roots, the VRAM floor, and the checkout paths. Stored as `cumuli.*` keys in
ComfyUI's own settings store; re-read at every queue, no restart. The final
`.sogst` + PLY land in the output gallery (ComfyUI's `--output-directory`).

## Before you queue
1. **Upload or pick your clip in the *Load Video* node** — 121 frames after
   `start_time` at 720p+ (~5 s at 24 fps), checked up front.
2. Keep the seed control on **fixed** so re-queues hit the cache.

## Caching — no toggles
Nodes re-run **only when inputs change** (ComfyUI semantics), extended to disk
for the expensive stages: unchanged re-queues reuse the finished ring and
checkpoint even across restarts ("CACHED RESULT"). Changing any input (seed,
prompt, LoRA...) regenerates from that stage on. Seed changes keep the motion
cache.

## Identity LoRAs — stock nodes, one toggle
The muted ALT branch at the top left is **ComfyUI's own** chain:
`Load Diffusion Model (4danyone_wan22_5b) → LoraLoaderModelOnly → Generate
Ring.model`. To enable: **unmute both nodes (Ctrl+B)** and set Generate Ring's
**prompt** widget to the trigger, e.g. `rin_karasuba, 视频中的人在做动作` —
without it the LoRA runs at half effect. Any LoRA trained on stock Wan 2.2
TI2V-5B works; stack loaders freely; folded and merged in the subprocess at
zero extra VRAM. Sweep strength 0.3–1.0. Enabling changes the ring
fingerprint, so the first LoRA run regenerates (correct: it is a new ring).

## Re-entry & real captures — the ALT loaders
The **Load Flipbook** and **Load 4DGS Dataset** nodes are muted ALTs feeding
Any Switch nodes: **unmute one (Ctrl+B) and its loaded artifact wins** over
the generated branch; mute it again to go back. Their dropdowns list artifacts
discovered under the work root + the Settings-dialog roots (↻ refreshes).
- *Load Flipbook* also accepts an external frame-major capture
  (`frame_NNNN/images_flat/<label>.png` + `transforms.json`) — this
  workflow's matting + hull then run on it.
- *Load 4DGS Dataset* takes any finished D-NeRF dataset straight into Train.

## Knobs that matter
| where | knob | note |
|---|---|---|
| Generate Ring | `enable_rcp` **on** | off = the back of the ring is invented per group, will not reconstruct |
| Generate Ring | `enable_turbo` **on** | 4DAnyone-Turbo: 4 denoising steps. Off runs the base model, much slower, and is what the older figures were measured on |
| Generate Ring | `views_per_group` **4** | 6 overruns 32 GB |
| Generate Ring | `prompt` | LoRA trigger words; empty = stock prompt |
| Build Dataset | `test_cameras` **12** | empty = PSNR is a training-view number |
| Train 4DGS | `sh_degree` | content-dependent: 3 won on a generated ring (+2.2 dB), 2 on a real capture |
| Bake SOGST | `mask_filter_root` link | lifetime mask-consistency filter (junk removal) |
| Bake SOGST | `fps` | advisory playback rate — match your source |
